description.value: East Kootenay Motel is a budget-friendly motel on Highway 3 in Fernie, BC, offering motel-style rooms including jacuzzi rooms and kitchenettes, with long stays welcome. Under new management as of June 2026 and currently undergoing upgrades. All rooms include wi-fi, air conditioning, microwave, coffee maker, and mini-fridge, and some rooms are pet-friendly.
